item.title: Litestream VFS
item.description:
📝 Open SQLite and: Wrap text Copy to clipboard $ sqlite3 SQLite version 3. Litestream VFS makes that easy. Where earlier Litestream blindly shipped whole raw SQLite pages to and from object storage, LTX ships ordered sets of pages.

item.title: Launch HN: BrowserBook (YC F24) – IDE for deterministic browser automation
item.description:
